PRMIA Risk Management Challenge 2027

A virtual financial-risk case competition for enrolled undergraduate and graduate students, with industry feedback and a creative-thinking team award.

PRIZE
To be announced
Reward details
Top two teams receive cash awards (amounts unspecified); scholarships and memberships are non-cash benefits.
Registration (conservative; official clocks conflict)
15 Feb 2027 (exact cutoff time not announced)
Format & location
Online · Worldwide
Who can apply
Any enrolled undergraduate or graduate student worldwide; cross-university teams and university-email verification. No coursework prerequisites.
Team size
3–4 participants

Entry notes

  • Fee US$200 per team early bird (about 5 January), US$300 after. Round 1 submission 22 February; case materials from 1 December.
  • Body text says 16 February, 11:29 IST; event metadata shows an earlier 15 February ending. Register well before 15 February.
  • Read the new 2027 handbook and AI/mentor policies before paying.
